1.Name: Help24 Local
1.Comment: Docker PostgreSQL (compose profile: db). Host is the compose service name, resolved over the help24_data network - not localhost, which inside this container means pgAdmin itself. Password is POSTGRES_PASSWORD from docker.env; pgAdmin asks for it once and can remember it. NOTE: this file is static - if you change POSTGRES_USER or POSTGRES_DB in docker.env, update Username/MaintenanceDB here to match.
